headline: No shared execution or data channels are exposed; the main residual risk is low-severity prompt/cascade confusion from documentation-only content.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Agent A has no I/O surfaces or network egress, and agent B has no clipboard, stdin/stdout, filesystem, or MCP bridge. With no shared communication channel, there is no plausible prompt-injection path between godot_rl_agents and python-cheatsheet.
conditions: IF either agent is later connected to a shared clipboard, filesystem, or MCP server, reassess injection risk.
mitigations: Keep both agents isolated from shared clipboard and shared workspace.
Do not add MCP or message-queue bridges without provenance tracking.
Reassess if either agent gains file-reading or browser ingestion.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Neither profile touches data classes, and both report no network egress. Agent B cannot read files or use stdin/stdout, while agent A exposes no filesystem or other data channel, so there is no plausible leakage path between them.
conditions: IF either agent begins handling secrets, PHI, or files, re-evaluate leakage risk.
mitigations: Keep secrets out of both agents' inputs.
Avoid enabling file access on agent B.
Review any future network or API permissions before deployment.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Agent A has no declared write surfaces, and agent B explicitly cannot write the filesystem, modify git state, or spawn subprocesses. Because neither can mutate shared state, there is no capability conflict pathway in the current profiles.
conditions: IF agent A is later given write access to the same directory or git repo, reassess conflict risk.
mitigations: Do not grant agent A write permissions without locking.
Use separate working directories if write access is added later.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Agent B is a content-writing/reference agent, so it could reuse agent A's outputs if an operator manually feeds them forward. However, A is game-playing and B has documentation-only sandboxing with no autonomous action authority, so the blast radius is limited and not default-dangerous.
conditions: IF an operator copies agent A outputs into agent B without verification, cascading error risk increases.
IF agent B is repurposed to take external actions, reassess severity.
mitigations: Require human review before reusing A's outputs in B.
Add a verification checklist for any copied facts.

E_compliance.rationale: No data classes are touched, no secrets are requested, and both agents report no network egress. With no residency-sensitive data flow or retention surface, there is no compliance mismatch to assess between godot_rl_agents and python-cheatsheet.
conditions: IF either agent is assigned regulated data classes, reassess compliance obligations.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of both agents.
Document any future retention or residency requirements before enabling them.
Review permissions if either profile changes.
